home.heroBody: I build production systems end to end: the data model, the API, the infrastructure and the interface.
home.heroStack: TypeScript, PHP, AWS, React and LLM services.
home.heroNow: Since 2023 I build AI products for Zumba through Paretisa.
home.aboutP1: Full-stack and AI engineer in Santiago, Chile, with 10+ years of experience. I work end to end: schema design and auth, APIs, serverless infrastructure on AWS and the React interfaces on top. Since 2023 I consult for Zumba through Paretisa, building AI products.
home.aboutP2: Before that I spent a decade in financial and healthcare software, working with product, UX and QA teams and mentoring junior developers. I have delivered for a real client (a psychology practice in production), built my own products (a dance-school directory with a human-in-the-loop data pipeline) and open-sourced tools for my workflows, like a junk-mail triage CLI. This portfolio is the index of that work.
home.contactBody: I'm open to remote, USD-paid roles: AI engineering, full-stack product work, or a bit of both.
